description: This file implements a NetworkManager proxy for RDK, handling network interface events, IP configuration, WiFi operations, and event registration via IARM bus, with JSON parsing for SSID lists and security mode mappings.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing network interfaces, WiFi, IP configurations, and event handling via IARM bus.

methods.name: platform_init
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus, registers event handlers, and retrieves initial network state.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces (eth0, wlan0) with status and type.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if specified interface (eth0/wlan0) is enabled.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for a given interface and IP version.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for a given interface and IP version.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Starts WiFi scan with optional frequency and SSID filtering.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds an SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to specified WiFi SSID with credentials.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves info of currently connected SSID.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing with specified method and PIN.
